findings.title: Top 5 Items by Gross Profit Contribution (Week 9-16 Mar 2026)
findings.claim: During the analysis period (2026-03-09 to 2026-03-16), the top 5 items by gross profit contribution generated 14003.50 SAR in total gross profit across 1059 baskets, representing 54.0% of total cafe gross profit.
coverage_notes: POS data filtered to analysis period 2026-03-09 to 2026-03-16
Refunds excluded from revenue and profit calculations
Menu unit costs merged on SKU; items without menu cost data excluded
Total POS line items in analysis period: 1899
assumptions: Menu unit_cost_sar is current and applicable to analysis period
Line totals in POS are net of discounts and represent actual revenue

findings.title: Quantified Waste Cost Impact (Week 9-16 Mar 2026)
findings.claim: Known waste cost during the analysis period totaled 1093.60 SAR across 6 inventory records, representing 2.93% of cafe revenue. Top waste contributor: Butter Croissant (268.00 SAR).
coverage_notes: Inventory data filtered to analysis period 2026-03-09 to 2026-03-16
Only non-null, positive known_waste_cost_sar values included
Inventory records with waste cost: 6 out of 6 total
Blank waste values excluded per schema guidance
Total cafe revenue (net of refunds): 37301.85 SAR
assumptions: known_waste_cost_sar in inventory is accurate and complete for non-null entries
Waste cost represents actual COGS loss
Revenue includes all non-refund POS transactions

findings.title: Supplier Price Change: Full-Fat Milk (Most Recent)
findings.claim: Email from orders@qatifdairy.com (received 2026-05-04) announces full-fat milk price change from 7.1 to 8.4 SAR/L, effective 2026-05-01. This represents a 18.31% price increase. Email receipt status: unknown. Impact on cafe margins cannot be quantified without standing order volume data and confirmed supplier relationship.
coverage_notes: Email extraction identified 4 price change records
Most recent price change analyzed: full-fat milk from orders@qatifdairy.com
Email receipt date is distinct from effective date; effective date is future-dated relative to analysis period
No recipe/BOM data available to calculate per-drink cost impact
Supplier identity and standing order applicability not confirmed in structured data
assumptions: Email sender is authoritative supplier (not independently verified)
Price change applies to cafe's standing orders (not confirmed)
No standing order volume data available; per-unit impact cannot be calculated
Effective date represents when price change takes effect; current period pricing unaffected
